title: EVA canonical contracts v2.0 (A00)
description: Self-contained contract bundle. Every internal '#/$defs/...' ref resolves inside this document. Validate a named contract with {"$ref": "#/$defs/<Name>", ...this document}.

ProposedActionStatus.description:
Lifecycle: pending -> approved -> executing -> succeeded/failed/unknown.

Other terminal/non-executable states: rejected, expired, superseded.
ProposedActionStatus.title: ProposedActionStatus

DecisionOutcome.description:
Internal outcome only. Recording it executes no payment, purchase,
supplier or contract commitment.
DecisionOutcome.title: DecisionOutcome

DeliveryDecision.description:
Notification delivery state of an AttentionItem (delivery only; never
affects action authorization).
DeliveryDecision.title: DeliveryDecision

SendUpdates.description: Google notification choice; part of the approved impact of a mutation.
SendUpdates.title: SendUpdates

Claim.description:
A single briefing/attention statement with provenance.

Invariant: historical facts require sources; inference and suggestion may
carry none but must never be presented as sourced fact.
Claim.title: Claim

Reason.description: Deterministic or preference/LLM-origin explanation bound to evidence.
Reason.title: Reason

Decision.description:
Fed exclusively by decision_required Attention items.

A recorded accept/reject is a local, audited outcome: it executes no
payment, purchase, supplier or contract commitment.
Decision.title: Decision

ProposedAction.description:
Immutable-by-revision mutation proposal bound to digest, policy version
and expiry. The LLM cannot choose authoritative risk or issue receipts.
ProposedAction.title: ProposedAction

ApprovalRequest.description:
Approval bound to action id, revision and arguments digest with a
one-time challenge. Channel is derived server-side, never client-supplied.
ApprovalRequest.title: ApprovalRequest

FocusSession.description: One active session; 'active' is derived from timestamps only.
FocusSession.title: FocusSession

FocusCompletionSummary.description:
Counts computed from stored, deduplicated Attention items received
during the session; no new LLM-generated counts.
FocusCompletionSummary.title: FocusCompletionSummary

ToolCall.description:
Model-produced call. Carries no authoritative risk or approval fields -
extra-field rejection enforces that boundary.
ToolCall.title: ToolCall

CalendarUpdateAgendaArguments.description:
Adds/updates an EVA-delimited section within the event description,
preserving all other text.
CalendarUpdateAgendaArguments.title: CalendarUpdateAgendaArguments

DecisionRecordOutcomeArguments.description:
Local outcome proposal for the Decision Inbox. Registered as
local_write; it never invokes an external financial API and sends no
message.
DecisionRecordOutcomeArguments.title: DecisionRecordOutcomeArguments

EventEnvelope.description:
Persisted with monotonic per-session sequence; consumers deduplicate by
event_id and reject stale request ids.
EventEnvelope.title: EventEnvelope

ProviderHealth.description:
Component readiness with structured identity where known.

``provider``/``model`` carry the actual configured provider and serving
model id (never guessed). Secrets, API keys, tokens and base-URL
credentials must never appear here - only presence flags belong in
sanitized responses elsewhere.
ProviderHealth.title: ProviderHealth

ApprovalChallengeResponse.description:
Direct response of POST /api/actions/{action_id}/challenge (route is
A04-owned; the contract is frozen here).

The raw one-time challenge travels ONLY in this direct authenticated API
response - never inside ProposedAction, ActionProposedPayload,
ActionStatusChangedPayload, EventEnvelope, ToolResult or any other durable
event/cache surface. There is deliberately no channel field: the approval
channel stays server-derived at confirmation time.
ApprovalChallengeResponse.title: ApprovalChallengeResponse

AttentionExplanationResponse.description:
Reads stored rule codes/evidence/policy version. Never newly invented
LLM justification.
AttentionExplanationResponse.title: AttentionExplanationResponse

CheckNowResponse.description: Invokes the same real ingestion path as polling.
CheckNowResponse.title: CheckNowResponse

DecisionOutcomeProposalRequest.description:
User-initiated local outcome proposal. Executes no payment, purchase,
supplier or contract commitment; for HIGH risk it requires explicit UI
confirmation through the standard approval flow.
DecisionOutcomeProposalRequest.title: DecisionOutcomeProposalRequest

FocusStopResponse.description:
An explicit stop always returns the completion summary computed from
persisted session items (same summary served after reconnect/restart via
GET /api/focus/{id}/summary).
FocusStopResponse.title: FocusStopResponse

LlmSettingsResponse.description:
Sanitized settings view. Secret values are never serialized - only
presence flags. Optional cloud permissions default to false and remain
false while no cloud adapter exists.
LlmSettingsResponse.title: LlmSettingsResponse

id.description: actual id exposed by the running server
id.title: Id

AudioInput.description: Backend-only: normalized 16 kHz mono PCM WAV bytes.
AudioInput.title: AudioInput
